messages:
jen: Heads-up — saw a large spike in hosted-api signups yesterday, ~720 -> 2.1k. Anyone know source? :eyes:
ashwin: Looking into raw leads now. initial filter shows utm_source=webinar for ~1.2k but utm_campaign=null. landing page had script that strips campaign param?
jen: That would explain mismatch vs GA. Did we run the 'Benchmarking webinar' promo last week? We used short links.
oliver: We used rwd.co/webinar-q1 — it's a redirect, GA client-side landing had _blank and lost querystring sometimes.
maria: We should not trust the dashboard until we unify attribution. I can run a canonical mapping that merges referer + utm + first_touch host.
ashwin: SQL quick check:
```sql
select count(*) as leads, coalesce(utm_campaign,'(none)') campaign
from raw.leads
where received_at >= '2026-03-18' and received_at < '2026-03-20'
group by 2;
```
ashwin: Results show 1.1k campaign=(none), 1.0k campaign=webinar-q1
lisa: So about half have blank campaign. That'll break paid vs organic attribution in the weekly KPI.
jen: For Monday KPI review we need a clean chart. Options: (1) patch dashboard to show 'inferred campaign' using referrer rule, (2) reprocess raw leads and backfill, (3) call it out as high uncertainty.
oliver: I'd vote for (1) + (3) short term. Reprocessing risks breaking downstream joins before the report deadline.
maria: I'll implement the inferred_campaign logic and update the 'Signup funnel' dashboard filter. Will do a light backfill for last 7 days only.
analytics-bot: weekly_digest: hosted-api signups +120% WoW; webinar traffic accounted for ~45% of attributed leads (pre-inference).
ashwin: Can you also add a small note in the KPI email: 'Attribution caveat: campaign param missing for ~40% of leads — see thread for details' ?
lisa: yes, add that to the subject line ⚠️
jen: Assign actions: Maria — infer+dash update (ETA EOD today); Ashwin — run backfill + share counts (ETA tomorrow 10am); Oliver — change redirect to preserve querystring (PR created); Lisa — update KPI email copy. :thumbsup:
maria: on it. linking PR once deployed.
oliver: PR -> #eng-infra for review.
nashwin: I'll post the cleaned numbers in the same chart once backfill done.
jen: Thanks team. This one affected webinar attribution narrative — we'll call it out in the postmortem annex for the campaign.
